critical_code_review_comments: Fix implementation is clean: single-point shim `const toast = { error: (msg,opts)=>rawToast({message:msg,kind:'error',...opts}), success: ... }` avoids editing every call site's signature.
Z_TOAST=10003 correctly added to the shared /app/frontend/src/lib/zIndex.js registry (comment explains the 9999→10003 rationale) — future regressions prevented.
Both toaster stacks (top-right + bottom-right) in Toast.jsx now use Z_TOAST from the registry.
Grep confirmed ZERO remaining `from "sonner"` imports in /app/frontend/src.
Minor: the shim in each of the 6 files is a small duplicated snippet (~4 lines). Could be extracted into a shared `lib/toastShim.js` if the shim ever needs to grow — not blocking.

context_for_next_testing_agent: The Toast system is now: (a) rendered by a single <Toaster/> from components/Toast.jsx mounted in App.jsx; (b) fired via `toast({message, kind, ...})` which dispatches window CustomEvent 'aurem:toast'; (c) callers using the sonner-style API import `{toast as rawToast} from './Toast'` and wrap it in `{error, success}` methods. Z_TOAST=10003 lives in lib/zIndex.js. To verify a toast rendered, listen for the 'aurem:toast' window event OR query `[data-testid=toast-error|toast-success|toast-info|toast-warn]` WITHIN the ~3.5s auto-dismiss window (default duration).
rca_of_the_issue: Two compounding pure-frontend bugs: (1) 6 files imported `toast` from sonner but sonner's <Toaster/> was never mounted (App.jsx only mounts custom Toast.jsx) → toast calls updated sonner internal state but rendered nothing to the DOM. (2) After routing through the real Toaster, its hardcoded z-index=9999 was BELOW VisibilityKitPanel's modal overlay (z=10000/10001), so the toast rendered correctly but was visually hidden behind the modal backdrop. Both fixed: (1) shim imports from './Toast', (2) shared registry bumped toaster to Z_TOAST=10003, above all modal layers. Verified live with real conflict on p_7c64e52386.
